title: Evidence
description: The result of one run of a check or eval, stored at <venture>/evidence/results/<id>.json (EE-017). It names what was checked, at which version, each assertion's outcome and the output that shows it. Results are append-only: a new run writes a new file. Handoffs point at results to prove their done-criteria. A test of a physical thing names the unit tested (subject.article), the conditions it ran under and each measured value with its unit, so a static fire or a load test is evidence like a passing suite.

version.description: Commit, tag or version the run checked

article.description: The unit tested, by serial or unit id, when the subject is a material object built in units (a booster, an engine, a batch)

suite.description: Path to the eval suite, when the run came from one

conditions.description: The conditions the run happened under, each a measured value with its unit (ambient temperature, chamber pressure, wind)

runner.description: Who or what ran it: a CI job, a session id, a role

criterion.description: A handoff done-criterion id, or an eval assertion name

kind.description: judged: scored by a model against a rubric, which counts as evidence only for review and evals, never conformance

output.description: The output, trimmed to what shows the outcome

artifact.description: Path or link to a screenshot, log or report

by.description: For review results: the role that judged it, which must be the criterion's reviewer and not the handoff's holder

measured.description: The values this result measured. A result cannot pass with a value outside its limit (packages/naive/src/checks/check-execution.mjs)

passed.description: True only when every result passed

quantity.description: What was measured: thrust, burn duration, mass

unit.description: A case-sensitive UCUM code (Unified Code for Units of Measure): kN, s, kg, Cel, kPa. Use 1 for a count or a ratio

limit.description: The range the value had to fall in, in the same unit, both ends included
